findings.finding: SuperX has an active $20m 2026 repurchase program authorised 2026-08-06, of which only about $0.97m had been used by 2026-09-08. It bought 119,360 shares at $7.7691 on 09-08, the last time the stock dipped below $8, so the issuer is a price-sensitive buyer with about $19m of room at a spot of $7.375 during the 09-23 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The authorisation is live through August 2027 and the company has bought on dips before (09-02 and 09-08, each disclosed within days). With spot about 5% below its last repurchase price, the 09-23 session is the first one in which it can bid at this level. The buying itself is not dated, which is why the size is small.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-09-01 fall of -13.04% the next close was +3.59%, and the 09-08 repurchase followed within the week. The 09-10 buyback-update release was followed by a 'drops over 2%' headline on 09-11 (cn.investing.com via marketbeat), so the announcement alone has not lifted the stock.
findings.why_not_priced: The close prices a stock with no stated buyer. What the tape has not taken is an issuer bid of up to about $1m a session, set against a 20-day median of $7.8m a day in turnover. If it were priced, the fall would have stopped near the $7.77 repurchase level rather than going through it.
findings.independence: The 09-09 release gives the 09-08 repurchase of 119,360 shares at $7.7691: https://macaubusiness.com/superx-announces-an-update-on-the-progress-of-share-repurchases-program-to-demonstrate-confidence-in-long-term-growth-value-2/
